faqs.a:
The following words, terms and phrases, when used in this article, shall have the
               meanings ascribed to them in this section, except where the context clearly indicates
               a different meaning:
Business guard
means any individual employed by an employer to protect persons, property, information,
               or other assets, or to preserve the peace in the conduct of that employer's business,
               and for the exclusive use of the employing individual or business, except any individual
               so employed by a common carrier engaged in interstate commerce.
Contract security agency
means any business that, for a fee or other consideration, agrees to furnish a uniformed
               security guard to protect persons, property, information, or other assets.
Security guard
means any private uniformed security officer, armored car service officer, alarm
               response runner, watchman, lobby attendant, or other private uniformed person who
               is engaged in the protection of persons, property, information, or other assets.
(Code 1981, § 21-92; Ord. No. 3739, § 2, 3-4-2002)
